description: This file defines data models and a class for managing channel statuses and configuration in a macOS application. It includes several Codable structs representing status snapshots for messaging services (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, IMessage) and channel account info, as well as a singleton class 'ChannelsStore' that manages state and metadata related to these channels.

classes.name: ChannelsStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the state and metadata of messaging channels, including their statuses, configuration, and UI hints.

methods.name: channelMetaEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the UI metadata entry for a specific channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Resolves and returns a user-friendly label for a channel ID, prioritizing UI metadata, then stored labels, and defaulting to the ID itself.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailLabel
methods.description: Resolves and returns a detailed label for a channel ID, prioritizing UI metadata, then stored detail labels, and defaulting to the main label.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Resolves and returns a system image name for a channel ID, prioritizing UI metadata, then stored images, and defaulting to 'message'.

methods.name: orderedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns the list of channel IDs ordered as per metadata; defaults to stored order if no metadata present.
